definitions.as_of: Only information public at end of this date belongs in the decision record
definitions.observed_at: Time our collector actually observed the URL (2026); not historical availability
definitions.original_published_at: Publication timestamp asserted by originating source, when available
definitions.source_first_seen_at: Only known when a contemporary crawl or immutable historical archive proves it
definitions.time_leakage: A modern API can expose historic dates plus facts updated after the as-of date; mark and quarantine
definitions.negative_results: A failed query / empty result / no public disclosure is NOT technical failure

hypotheses.thesis: FDA indication expansion removes the clinical adoption bottleneck
hypotheses.measurable: FDA PMA approvals and supplements with decision dates
hypotheses.falsifier: approval narrower than addressable DCD cases; contraindications or safety setbacks
hypotheses.limitations: a current PMA record can include supplements entered after the cutoff

hypotheses.thesis: independent transplant evidence validates superiority over cold storage
hypotheses.measurable: dated peer-reviewed trial results and registered endpoints
hypotheses.falsifier: no clinical outcome improvement, low external replication or weak trial design
hypotheses.limitations: modern citation counts leak future knowledge; paper publication date != article first online date

hypotheses.thesis: the product becomes a procedure-level recurring-revenue platform rather than equipment-only sales
hypotheses.measurable: 2022 Q3 per-organ revenue in SEC financial statements + hospitals + utilization
hypotheses.falsifier: growth only due to acquisitions / consumables not recurring / poor organ utilization
hypotheses.limitations: OPTN aggregate volume does not prove company market share; SEC source should use exact filing receipt time

hypotheses.thesis: technical uncertainty falls as ordinary phones achieve voice then 4G then 5G with increasing throughput
hypotheses.measurable: test dated milestones, spectral efficiency, unmodified handset, throughput
hypotheses.falsifier: non-repeatable controlled demos; insufficient spectral efficiency or unusable coverage
hypotheses.limitations: reported speeds primarily issuer claims until independently validated

hypotheses.thesis: carriers will commit resources once interoperability succeeds
hypotheses.measurable: named commercial agreements and payment commitments, not just memoranda
hypotheses.falsifier: nonbinding MOU, no minimum payments, spectrum/licensing unavailable
hypotheses.limitations: contract signing alone is not equivalent to launch revenue

hypotheses.thesis: regulatory path converges as spectrum experimental authority permits field tests
hypotheses.measurable: experimental radio authorizations, conditions, filing dates
hypotheses.falsifier: limited/suspended experimental licenses, interference or coordination failures
hypotheses.limitations: official FCC ELS/IBFS may lack reliable unauthenticated API; documents must be joined by FRN/filing no.

hypotheses.thesis: commercial launch supplier is now trusted as a satellite prime contractor
hypotheses.falsifier: nonrecurring one-off award, low gross margin or contract milestones delayed
hypotheses.limitations: SDA external identification announced Jan 2024; at 2023-12-22 the 8-K named a US customer, not SDA

hypotheses.thesis: launches are increasingly reliable, lowering operational risk
hypotheses.measurable: per-mission launch outcome, turnaround, customer payload, not generic press count
hypotheses.falsifier: mission failures, repeated scrubs or deteriorating unit economics
hypotheses.limitations: historical launch database backfills may change after cutoff

hypotheses.thesis: a second growth curve is satellite hardware and systems rather than rocket launches only
hypotheses.measurable: 2024 Q2 segment backlog and customers + government contracts
hypotheses.falsifier: backlog contains options/cancelable programs, cash burn or revenue recognition delays
hypotheses.limitations: a June 30 period-end amount was not public until Q2 filing date; event date must be filing publication date

hypotheses.thesis: quantum hardware utility increases as benchmark performance improves
hypotheses.measurable: independent gate fidelity, circuit depth, two-qubit error, benchmark reproducibility
hypotheses.falsifier: company-specific AQ score fails third-party benchmark or economically relevant task
hypotheses.limitations: #AQ is company-selected benchmark; not directly comparable to error-corrected logical qubits

hypotheses.thesis: quantum capability is being adopted by independent developers
hypotheses.measurable: dated third-party SDK repositories, release history, reproducible experiments
hypotheses.falsifier: repos are company authored, education demos, or usage is negligible
hypotheses.limitations: current stars and fork counts are hindsight; API repository creation date is not adoption history

hypotheses.thesis: autonomous delivery robots cross from demo to positive unit economics
hypotheses.measurable: paid deliveries per robot, utilization, cost per delivery, human intervention rate
hypotheses.falsifier: pilot fleets do not convert to scaled, low-intervention profitable deliveries
hypotheses.limitations: public disclosure may be too sparse to calculate unit economics; report unavailable not zero
